alt: Full 13-Page DHCS Medi-Cal Rx Claim Mischaracterization and Tracking Packet.
summary: This evidence consists of the complete 13-page packet from DHCS/Medi-Cal Rx, dated March 11, 2026, along with its USPS Certified Mail tracking and receipt proof. The packet documents the state's unilateral attempt to mischaracterize a provider visit reimbursement claim as a pharmacy claim, directing the Operator to submit CVS Pharmacy information only. This is the origin of L.A. Care's subsequent deflection argument under AB 3275.
full_text: Full 13-Page DHCS Medi-Cal Rx Claim Mischaracterization and Tracking Packet, including the March 11, 2026 Additional Information Required letter, Provider Information Form, STD 204 Payee Data Record, Nondiscrimination Notice, Language Taglines, and USPS Certified Mail Electronic Delivery Confirmation.
